source.title: Staged docs for Spending by Transaction

observations.statement: The documented endpoint is POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_transaction/ on https://api.usaspending.gov.
Top-level documented request fields are filters, fields, limit, page, sort, and order.
The endpoint docs describe the route as returning transaction records which match the provided filters.
The documented response includes results, page_metadata, and limit.
Documented page_metadata members are page, hasNext, hasPrevious, next, and previous.

source.title: AdvancedFilterObject and FieldNameObject in Spending by Transaction docs

observations.statement: The documented AdvancedFilterObject members are keywords, description, time_period, award_type_codes, place_of_performance_scope, place_of_performance_locations, agencies, recipient_search_text, recipient_scope, recipient_locations, recipient_type_names, award_ids, award_amounts, program_numbers, naics_codes, tas_codes, psc_codes, contract_pricing_type_codes, set_aside_type_codes, extent_competed_type_codes, treasury_account_components, program_activity, program_activities, def_codes, and award_unique_id.
The docs say time_period searches use the transaction action_date field and require start_date plus end_date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
AgencyObject requires type, tier, and name; toptier_name is optional and only applicable when tier is subtier.
ProgramActivityObject requires at least one of name or code when used.
Award IDs wrapped in double quotes are documented to perform exact matches instead of the default fuzzier full-text matching.

If the supplied def_codes are in the COVID-19 or IIJA groups, the docs say returned transactions must also satisfy an associated public-law enactment-date rule relative to the transaction action_date.

Documented requestable field labels are Action Date, Action Type, Assistance Listing, Award ID, Award Type, Awarding Agency, Awarding Sub Agency, awarding_agency_id, Funding Agency, Funding Sub Agency, internal_id, generated_internal_id, Issued Date, Last Date to Order, Loan Value, Mod, NAICS, PSC, Primary Place of Performance, recipient_id, Recipient Location, Recipient Name, Recipient UEI, Subsidy Cost, Transaction Amount, Transaction Description, and def_codes.

source.title: TransactionResponse and sample response in Spending by Transaction docs

observations.statement: The documentation presents results as array[TransactionResponse] with a fixed-type row shape.

The sample TransactionResponse includes Action Date, Award ID, Award Type, Awarding Agency, Awarding Sub Agency, internal_id, generated_internal_id, Mod, optional recipient_id, Recipient Name, and Transaction Amount.

The docs also list a default TransactionResponse field set including awarding_agency_id, Funding Agency, Funding Sub Agency, Issued Date, Last Date to Order, Loan Value, Subsidy Cost, and Transaction Amount.
The view builds allowed fields from TransactionField plus five derived labels: Assistance Listing, NAICS, Primary Place of Performance, PSC, and Recipient Location.
If the sort field is not present in the request fields array, the view raises InvalidParameterException with the message "Sort value not found in fields".
The view special-cases award_type_codes containing "no intersection" and immediately returns a 200 response with empty results and page metadata.
On the normal path, keyword filters are sanitized into keyword_search before the Elasticsearch query executes.
The response builder iterates only over the requested fields to populate row columns, then appends generated_internal_id from generated_unique_award_id and internal_id from award_id to every row.

Derived response objects have source-defined nested shapes: Assistance Listing returns cfda_number and cfda_title; NAICS returns code and description; PSC returns code and description; Primary Place of Performance returns country/state/city/county/congressional/zip fields; Recipient Location returns country/state/city/county/address/congressional/zip and foreign postal fields.
On the normal path the response includes messages from get_generic_filters_message(request["filters"].keys(), [elem["name"] for elem in self.models]).
The search uses QueryType.TRANSACTIONS, which grounds the endpoint as a transaction search rather than an award search.
Sorting by Recipient Location, Primary Place of Performance, NAICS, PSC, or Assistance Listing expands into multiple Elasticsearch sort fields rather than a single source column.

source.title: Shared award filter and pagination validators used by transaction search

observations.statement: Shared pagination rules set page default 1 with minimum 1, limit default 10 with maximum 100, and order default desc.
This view explicitly forces award_type_codes and sort to be non-optional in the TinyShield model.
The view blocks requests whose record offset (page-1)*limit is greater than or equal to the ES transaction max result window of 50000.
Source validator enforces keywords as an array of text strings with minimum length 3.
Source validator accepts filters.time_period[].date_type values action_date, last_modified_date, date_signed, and new_awards_only even though the endpoint docs only describe action_date.
Source validator accepts an undocumented filters.recipient_id text field.

Source validator defines StandardLocationObject-style recipient_locations and place_of_performance_locations with country required and optional state, zip, district_original, district_current, county, and city.

The transaction search view adds a separate program_activities rule requiring at least one of name or code in each object, but the validator model for this endpoint does not add the documented program_activity array field.

source.title: TransactionField enum and Elasticsearch field mappings

observations.statement: TransactionField maps Transaction Amount to the transaction-search field federal_action_obligation.
TransactionField maps Award ID to display_award_id, internal_id to award_id, and generated_internal_id to generated_unique_award_id.

TransactionField maps Recipient UEI, Transaction Description, Funding Agency, Funding Sub Agency, Issued Date, Last Date to Order, Loan Value, and Subsidy Cost to concrete source fields in the transaction search index.

source.title: Generic helper pagination and messages used by transaction search

observations.statement: get_simple_pagination_metadata derives hasNext by checking whether the implementation fetched one extra row beyond limit.
get_generic_filters_message always includes a time-period earliest-date warning and appends an unused-filter warning when original_filters contain members outside the allowed filters list.

source.title: Derived coverage and workflow assessment for transaction search

observations.statement: Because the view executes QueryType.TRANSACTIONS and returns one row per Elasticsearch hit, repeated Award IDs across rows are expected and row counts are not award counts.
Transaction Amount is safe for transaction-level ranking or summing across returned rows, but unsafe as a substitute for award-level Award Amount or outlay totals.
generated_internal_id is the most reusable parent-award handoff value on this endpoint because source code appends it to every row even when the caller did not request it.
A bounded time_period is the safest first-pass request pattern because the endpoint is row-level and otherwise can scan a very broad transaction population.

source.title: Live bounded contract transaction baseline probe

messages: For searches, time period start and end dates are currently limited to an earliest date of 2007-10-01.  For data going back to 2000-10-01, use either the Custom Award Download feature on the website or one of our download or bulk_download API endpoints as listed on https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/endpoints.

observations.statement: A bounded POST with filters.time_period 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31, award_type_codes A/B/C/D, eight projected columns, page=1, limit=2, sort=Transaction Amount, and order=desc returned HTTP 200 JSON.
The live response confirmed transaction-grain rows with requested fields plus generated_internal_id and internal_id helper ids, even though those helper ids were not requested in fields.

The first two live rows were Department of the Navy contract transactions for Lockheed Martin and Electric Boat, with Transaction Amount values 7384655472 and 2644813959 respectively, proving that Transaction Amount can appear as a numeric JSON value rather than a string.
The live response included page_metadata.page=1, next=2, hasNext=true, hasPrevious=false and a messages array with the generic earliest-search-date warning.

source.title: Live derived Recipient Location preview probe

messages: For searches, time period start and end dates are currently limited to an earliest date of 2007-10-01.  For data going back to 2000-10-01, use either the Custom Award Download feature on the website or one of our download or bulk_download API endpoints as listed on https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/endpoints.

observations.statement: A request using fields Award ID, Action Date, Transaction Amount, and Recipient Location with sort=Action Date and order=asc returned HTTP 200, confirming ascending order is accepted in a bounded request shape.

The live row for Award ID SPE2D924F1098 returned Recipient Location as a nested object rather than a flat string, with location_country_code, country_name, state_code, state_name, city_name, county_code, county_name, address_line1, address_line2, address_line3, congressional_code, zip4, zip5, foreign_postal_code, and foreign_province keys.
The same live row kept generated_internal_id and internal_id helper ids even in a request centered on the derived Recipient Location field.

bodySample.detail: Sort value not found in fields: Action Date

observations.statement: A request whose sort value Action Date was not present in fields returned HTTP 400 with detail "Sort value not found in fields: Action Date".
This live failure confirms that sort membership in the fields array is enforced as a hard validation rule rather than a soft preference.
A request using filters.award_type_codes=["no intersection"] returned HTTP 200 with an empty results array and page_metadata.hasNext=false, hasPrevious=false, next=null, previous=null.
The live short-circuit response omitted messages entirely, unlike the normal search path that includes the generic earliest-search-date warning.

source.title: Live agency-scoped DoD contract transaction probe

messages: For searches, time period start and end dates are currently limited to an earliest date of 2007-10-01.  For data going back to 2000-10-01, use either the Custom Award Download feature on the website or one of our download or bulk_download API endpoints as listed on https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/endpoints.

observations.statement: A bounded request with filters.agencies [{name:"Department of Defense", tier:"toptier", type:"awarding"}] returned HTTP 200 and five transaction rows.
All five returned rows had Awarding Agency = Department of Defense, confirming that the awarding toptier agency filter object works for this endpoint in a bounded contract transaction screen.
This live agency-scoped request produced a practical screening template for top Department of Defense contract transactions in calendar year 2024.
